app.name: Helios
app.tagline: Your own flight surgeon, when Earth is too far to call.
import.privacy: Your health file is read on this device only. Nothing is uploaded.
hk.privacy: Health data is read on this device only. Nothing is uploaded.
baseline.explainer: We compare you with your own normal, because the same number can be fine for one person and a warning sign for another.
baseline.learning: No history for this yet; using general ranges.
overall.unknown: Not enough data yet. Add a measurement or connect a source.
draft.tag: Draft guidance: not yet reviewed against official sources.
empty.trends: No data for this indicator yet. Add a measurement or connect a source.
empty.sources: Nothing connected. You can start with the simulator.
error.file: We couldn't read that file. Check that it's an Apple Health export (export.xml) or a CSV/JSON file.
error.bridge: Bridge not found on this computer. Start it with the command below or use simulated radiation.
quest.broken: No problem, pick up where you left off.
quest.paused: Quests are paused until the escalation is acknowledged. Your health comes first.
escalation.prompt: This needs attention. {reason}. Contact your flight surgeon per mission procedures.
escalation.contact.default: Contact the flight surgeon / mission control per mission procedures.
